artworks.title: The Judgement of Paris
artworks.description: Rubens' Paris and the goddesses — the choice that led to the duel on the plain and the broken truce of Iliad 3–4.

artworks.title: Helen Brought to Paris
artworks.description: West's Helen — the prize Menelaus fought for on the plain while she watched from Troy's wall.

artworks.title: The Oath of the Horatii
artworks.description: David's oath before battle — the spirit of the sacrificial truce Pandarus' arrow would shatter on the Trojan plain.
